g.text: You: I rebuilt our batch pipeline to incremental loads — cut runtime
Interviewer: How did you keep correctness with late-arriving data?
You: Idempotent watermark-based reprocessing with a DLQ for out-of-o
Interviewer: Strong. Any SLA misses during the migration?
You: Zero over a quarter; we shadow-ran both paths for two weeks fir
Needs evidence — open a grilling sess
